name: Nitrobenzene reduction to aniline
conditions: Sn/HCl or Fe/HCl, followed by base work-up; catalytic hydrogenation is another route
summary: Nitro group reduction માં N aromatic carbon સાથે જોડાયેલો જ રહે છે; NO₂ થી NH₂ conversion થાય છે.
why: Metal/acid conditions માં amine protonated salt રૂપે હોય શકે છે. Neutral aniline બતાવતાં basic work-up ધ્યાનમાં લો.
steps: Ring–N bond retained રાખો.
Two O દૂર થઈ N–H bonds વધે છે તે જુઓ.
Medium પ્રમાણે anilinium salt કે free aniline લખો.
trap: Nitro reduction ring પર NH₂ substitute કરતું direct aromatic amination નથી; existing N retained છે.

quiz.question: What organic product forms after nitrobenzene reduction and neutralisation?

name: Nitrile vs amide reduction: count carbons
conditions: LiAlH₄ and work-up; nitriles may also undergo catalytic hydrogenation
summary: Nitrile carbon અને amide carbonyl carbon બંને reduction માં chain નો part રહે છે. તેથી nitrile/amide reduction one-carbon loss કરતું નથી.
why: Hofmann rearrangement primary amide ને one-carbon-shorter amine આપે છે; LiAlH₄ reduction carbonyl carbon retain કરે છે.
steps: Starting group નો functional carbon label કરો.
તે carbon ને product CH₂–N carbon સાથે match કરો.
Hofmann degradation સાથે carbon count compare કરો.
trap: Acetamide થી LiAlH₄ સાથે methylamine નહીં, ethylamine મળે છે.

quiz.question: What does LiAlH₄ reduction of acetamide give?

name: Amine basicity: gas phase vs water
equation: Lower pKb = stronger base; aqueous order depends on solvation and alkyl group.
summary: N lone pair ની availability amine basicity માટે મહત્વની છે. Alkyl +I donation basicity વધારી શકે છે, પરંતુ aqueous solvation અને steric effects order બદલી શકે છે.
why: Aniline માં lone pair ring સાથે delocalise થાય છે, તેથી simple alkylamines કરતાં generally weaker base છે. Gas-phase order ને blindly aqueous order ન બનાવો.
steps: Solvent/phase વાંચો.
Lone-pair resonance અને inductive effects જુઓ.
Conjugate-acid solvation અને steric factors consider કરો.
trap: Aqueous methylamine અને ethylamine series માં 1°/3° relative order identical હોવો જરૂરી નથી.

quiz.question: Why is aniline generally less basic than ethylamine?
quiz.answer: Its N lone pair is delocalised into the aromatic ring
distractors: Its nitrogen is replaced by oxygen

name: Protect aniline before controlled nitration
summary: NH₂ ને acetyl group થી protect કરતાં ring activation moderate થાય છે. Nitration પછી protecting group hydrolyse કરીને NH₂ પાછું મળે છે.
why: Strong acid માં unprotected aniline protonate થઈ meta-directing anilinium character આપે છે અને product mixture બને છે. Acetanilide ortho/para directing છે; para product commonly favoured છે.
steps: NH₂ → NHCOCH₃ protection કરો.
Nitration માં ring position control જુઓ.
Hydrolysis થી N-acetyl group દૂર કરો.
trap: Protection પછી NHCOCH₃ group ને meta director ન કહો.

quiz.question: Why is aniline often acetylated before nitration?
quiz.answer: To moderate activation and improve controlled ortho/para substitution
distractors: To convert the ring to an alkene

name: Aniline gives 2,4,6-tribromoaniline with bromine water
summary: NH₂ strongly activates aromatic ring. Aqueous bromination readily ortho/para multiple substitution આપે છે.
why: Controlled monobromination માટે N-protection strategy helpful છે. Product માં amino group retain થાય છે; bromination N removal નથી.
steps: NH₂ ની ortho/para sites mark કરો.
2,4,6 substitution product દોરો.
Unprotected અને protected amine reactivity compare કરો.
trap: Aniline + bromine water નું main textbook product p-bromoaniline only નથી.

quiz.question: What is the usual product from aniline and bromine water?

name: Primary aliphatic amines with nitrous acid
conditions: Nitrous acid generated in situ; conceptual reactivity comparison
summary: Primary aliphatic amine ના diazonium-like intermediates unstable હોય છે; nitrogen evolution સાથે alcohol-containing products મળી શકે છે.
why: Primary aromatic amines cold conditions માં relatively persistent diazonium salts બનાવી શકે છે. Aliphatic systems માં rearrangements/other products શક્ય છે; simple equation model છે.
steps: Amine aliphatic છે કે aromatic તે ઓળખો.
Nitrogen gas loss ની driving force યાદ રાખો.
Stable isolated aromatic diazonium salt rule aliphatic case પર ન લગાવો.
trap: Primary aliphatic diazonium salt ને ordinary stable bottled intermediate તરીકે ન બતાવો.

quiz.question: Which gas is characteristically evolved when a primary aliphatic amine reacts with nitrous acid?

name: Warm diazonium solution: make a phenol
summary: Aryl diazonium group OH થી replace થઈ શકે છે અને stable N₂ gas નીકળે છે. Aniline થી phenol route માં diazotisation useful bridge છે.
why: Cold diazotisation conditions અને warm hydrolysis conditions ને અલગ રાખો. આ ordinary aryl SN2 નથી.
steps: Starting Ar–N₂⁺ bond ઓળખો.
Diazonium group ની જગ્યાએ OH મૂકો.
Ring skeleton retained અને N₂ lost છે તે count કરો.
trap: Cl⁻ counterion હોવા છતાં warm water route નો organic product necessarily chlorobenzene નથી.

quiz.question: What forms on warming an aqueous benzenediazonium salt solution?

name: Diazonium conversion map: KI or H₃PO₂
equation: ArN₂⁺ → ArI with KI   |   ArN₂⁺ → ArH with H₃PO₂
conditions: KI: iodide replacement; H₃PO₂: reductive replacement by H
summary: Diazonium group different reagents સાથે different substituents આપે છે. KI aryl iodide અને hypophosphorous acid Ar–H endpoint આપે છે.
why: આ synthetic map માં N₂ leaving group છે. Sandmeyer, Balz–Schiemann અને azo coupling ના existing cards related alternatives તરીકે જુઓ.
steps: Target group I કે H છે તે નક્કી કરો.
Corresponding reagent પસંદ કરો.
Starting ring substituents unchanged રાખો.
trap: Aryl iodide formation માટે every case માં Cu(I) salt જરૂરી નથી; KI conversion અલગ textbook route છે.

quiz.question: Which reagent replaces an aryl diazonium group by hydrogen?
